title: Fish, Acute Toxicity Testing
species: Freshwater, estuarine, or marine fish (e.g., Zebrafish, Rainbow Trout); see Annex 2
animals: Minimum of 7 fish per concentration and control
dose_groups: At least 5 concentrations in a geometric series (or Limit Test at 100 mg/L)

title: Acute Dermal Toxicity: Fixed Dose Procedure
animals: Sequential single animals; generally 2 animals per dose level
dose_groups: Stepwise procedure using fixed doses (50, 200, 1000, 2000 mg/kg bw)

title: Acute Inhalation Toxicity
duration: Usually 4 hours (Traditional); multiple durations up to 6 hours (C x t)
animals: Traditional Main: 5 males + 5 females; Sighting: 3 males + 3 females; Limit: 3 males + 3 females; C x t: 1-2 animals/sex/concentration/time
dose_groups: At least 3 concentrations (Traditional Main); Single limit concentration (Limit test); Multiple concentrations/durations (C x t)
route: Inhalation (Nose-only preferred; Whole-body possible with justification)

title: Skin Sensitisation Guinea Pig Maximisation Test and Buehler Test
animals: GPMT: Min 10 treated, 5 control; Buehler: Min 20 treated, 10 control
dose_groups: At least 1 test group + 1 control group

title: Uterotrophic Bioassay in Rodents: A short-term screening test for oestrogenic properties
species: Rat (preferred); Mouse (limited to OVX adult method)
dose_groups: Minimum of 2 treatment groups + 1 control group

title: Avian Dietary Toxicity Test
species: Mallard duck, Bobwhite quail, Pigeon, Japanese quail, Ring-necked pheasant, Red-legged partridge
duration: Minimum 8 days (5 days exposure + 3 days recovery)
dose_groups: At least 5 test groups + 2 control groups

title: Repeated Dose Dermal Toxicity: 21/28-day Study
dose_groups: At least 3 dose levels + control (+ vehicle control if appropriate)

title: Hershberger Bioassay in Rats: A Short-term Screening Assay for (Anti)Androgenic Properties
dose_groups: Min 2 test groups (androgenic); Min 3 test groups (antiandrogenic)

title: Acute Dermal Irritation/Corrosion
duration: Up to 14 days observation period (4 hours exposure)
animals: Initial test: 1 animal; Confirmatory test: up to 2 additional animals
dose_groups: Single dose application (0.5 mL liquid or 0.5 g solid/paste)

title: Acute Oral Toxicity – Acute Toxic Class Method
species: Rat (preferred); other rodent species may be used. Females are normally used.
animals: 3 animals per step (single sex, normally females)
dose_groups: Stepwise procedure using fixed doses (5, 50, 300, 2000 mg/kg; optionally 5000 mg/kg)

title: Prenatal developmental toxicity study
duration: From implantation to one day prior to scheduled caesarean section
animals: Sufficient to result in approx. 20 females with implantation sites
dose_groups: At least three dose levels + control

title: Two-Generation Reproduction Toxicity Study
duration: Two generations (P and F1 dosed for at least 10 weeks prior to mating, plus mating, gestation, lactation, and weaning of F2)
animals: Sufficient to yield preferably not less than 20 pregnant females at parturition
dose_groups: At least three dose levels and a concurrent control
route: Oral (diet, drinking water, or gavage); other routes possible with justification
